newsitem.title: DENMARK: NOVO TO DELAY U.S. LAUNCH OF NOVOSEVEN.
newsitem.headline: NOVO TO DELAY U.S. LAUNCH OF NOVOSEVEN.

text.p: Danish pharmaceutical group Novo Nordisk said on Wednesday that it was delaying the launch of its NovoSeven haemophilia treatment in the United States to allow further clinical study.
The product had been set for release this year but a statement accompanying Novo's first-half results said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had asked for more trials.

"At the request of the FDA a further clinical study will be initiated prior to marketing of NovoSeven in the U.S. Launch of the product is now expected to take place in the first half of 1998," it said.

It added that worldwide sales of the treatment amounted to 149 million crowns in the first six months of 1997, almost treble the total of the first half of 1996 when the product was first introduced. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +(45) 33 969650
